contentBody: **What is an automation workflow in simple terms?**
option.1: A manual checklist that people tick off on paper
option.2: Connected steps that run automatically after a trigger
option.3: A spreadsheet listing all your tasks and their due dates
option.4: A meeting agenda for the whole team to follow each week
answerExplanation: A workflow is "when this happens, do that", with no one doing the steps by hand.

contentBody: **Under n8n's Sustainable Use License, what would need a separate commercial agreement?**
option.1: Self-hosting it on a server for your own team
option.2: Using it for your own internal business tasks
option.3: Reselling it to clients as a hosted service
option.4: Using it for your own personal projects
answerExplanation: Internal and personal use are allowed; reselling n8n as a service is not.

contentBody: **How should n8n be described most accurately in writing?**
option.1: Fair-code: public source code, with some use limits
option.2: Public domain, free for anyone to use for anything
option.3: Fully open source, with no limits at all on any use
option.4: Closed source, with all of its code kept private
answerExplanation: Its source is public but the licence limits commercial reselling, so "fair-code" is the accurate term.

contentBody: **Which of these tasks is the best candidate for automation?**
option.1: Deciding which lead deserves a personal call
option.2: Comforting an upset or angry customer
option.3: Negotiating a discount with a client
option.4: Logging every form entry into a shared sheet
answerExplanation: It has a clear trigger, fixed rules and digital data; the others need judgement or empathy.

contentBody: **What makes a process a good automation candidate in practice?**
option.1: It needs human judgement and empathy every time
option.2: It only happens about once or twice a year
option.3: It follows clear, fixed rules and repeats very often
option.4: It relies on paper records and handwritten forms alone
answerExplanation: Rule-based, digital, frequent work repays the effort of automating it.
